rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone or an approach that is aggressively in-your-face.

example.english: They were so confrontational in the meeting that nobody at the table dared speak.
example.traditional: 佢開會嗰陣咄咄逼人，搞到成枱人都唔敢出聲。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hoi1 wui2 go2 zan6 cyut3 cyut3 bik1 jan4 gaau2 dou3 seng4 ci4 jan4 dou1 m4 gam2 ceot1 seng1

rows.note: Use this when the confrontational quality is mainly a hostile attitude rather than active provocation.

example.english: Their tone was confrontational; I was only asking the time.
example.traditional: 佢語氣有敵意，我只係問句時間啫。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jyu5 hei3 jau5 dik6 ji3 ngo5 zi2 hai6 man6 geoi3 si4 gaan3 ze1

rows.note: Use this when someone or something is deliberately provocative and likely to initiate a confrontation.

example.english: Mocking someone in public like that is really confrontational, so no wonder they got angry.
example.traditional: 你咁樣當眾笑人，真係好挑釁，唔怪得人哋嬲。
example.jyutping: nei5 gam3 joeng2 dong1 zung3 siu3 jan4 zan1 hai6 hou2 tiu1 jan6 m4 gwaai3 dak1 jan4 dei6 niu5
